eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 9:17 PM on JUL 24, 2026 Effective until 9:17 PM JUL 25, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Only Big Pine Canyon is under the new evacuation order.  The populated area of Big Pine is under an evacuation warning.  A technical error caused the order to be placed county wide. We apologize for this error.
